centroid_method: Normalized mean of original1024-dimensional BGE vectors for Jev primary-topic members, equal segment weights
size: Bubble area, not diameter, proportional to segment count or distinct episode count
colors: 20 unique colors selected from the user-provided named color list
unassigned: 389 unassigned segments excluded; no coherent centroid implied
coordinate_scope: Jev member centroids, not original model-cluster centroids. Both views share the same coordinates.
